title: Buckwheat Soba with Roasted Shrimp and Snap Peas
blurb: Nutty soba noodles with roasted shrimp, sweet snap peas and a bright lemon-garlic dressing
steps: Heat your oven to 220°C. Thaw the shrimp if frozen, then pat them completely dry with kitchen paper.
Peel and finely chop the garlic and ginger. Trim and slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts separate.
Toss the shrimp with half the olive oil, half the garlic and a pinch of salt on a baking tray. Roast for 8 to 10 minutes until just cooked through and lightly golden.
Meanwhile, bring a large pan of water to the boil. Cook the soba noodles according to the packet instructions, adding the snap peas for the final 2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, remaining olive oil, remaining garlic, ginger and the white parts of the spring onions.
Toss the drained noodles and snap peas with the dressing in a large bowl.
Divide the noodles between four bowls, top with the roasted shrimp and scatter over the green spring onion slices and sesame seeds.
